variant.headline: Automated - except the last click
variant.body: Journal matching is free. Compare fit and review time, then press Submit yourself. ToS-safe by design.
variant.angle: 역설·반전-tos_safe (broadened to free matching so non-authors still engage)

top_blockers: As an operations specialist she never submits to academic journals, so journal matching is irrelevant to her work.
A transportation attendant has no papers to submit to journals.
Retail salesperson with no manuscripts sees nothing to match despite liking automation and tech.
She reads medical journals but is retiring and never submits research articles herself.
An accountant produces audits, not journal manuscripts needing submission.
